content_of_post_to_comment: Imagine finding out about your theory that two classes of objects or properties have no necessary connection but inexplicably always coincide, and concluding “Wow somebody must have designed this coincidence to come out just so” and not “I am perhaps calling one type of thing by two names”
comment: A useful distinction here is between a genuine explanatory gap and a gap created by our categories. Before invoking design, it may be worth asking whether the separation we assumed is actually real.
